mechanisms.limits: Original paper uses unscaled masks and per-example connection masks. Gaussian moment matching gives .2820948 versus exact Bernoulli ReLU average .25, not an exact ensemble.

mechanisms.example: x=[1,2], F=[3,4], q=.5: original mean [2.5,4], inverted mean [4,6]; coordinate dropout [7,2] cannot come from a single branch gate. Four-block mean active depth 2.75.
mechanisms.limits: Original mini-batch gate differs from per-example timm [B,1,1]. scale_by_keep=False alone does not supply the paper's evaluation factor. Zeroing an already-computed branch saves no branch forward computation.

No renormalization; forbidden zero stays zero. A fully dropped row is not an all-minus-infinity softmax row. Fixed-A,V expectation does not imply a nonlinear loss expectation. Residual and embedding masks act at their own locations.
